title: Metric-triangulation: 3 ECA descriptors disagree on rule ranking (n=4 ring)
question: Do 3 independent ECA descriptors (mean cycle length · mean active bits · unique state count) AGREE on the top-ranked rule with majority (≥2 of 3 pick the same)?
engine: pure hexa-lang. Each descriptor computed INDEPENDENTLY from the same 16-state forward orbit. No IIT4 import.

rule_204_anchor.note: identity sanity — C top is shared with consc class, exposes C's class-blindness

ranking_top.C_unique_states: rule_105 ∨ rule_150 ∨ rule_204 (16, all tied — bijection class)

agreement_test.verdict: DISAGREE — 3 descriptors pick 3 different rules; zero pairwise overlap on the single top rule

falsifier_eval.F329_1_MAJORITY_AGREE: FAIL — A picks rule_30, B picks rule_110, C picks rule_105/150 (and rule_204!). 0/3 agree on a single top rule
falsifier_eval.F329_2_NON_ORTHOGONAL: FAIL — each descriptor's top differs, suggesting descriptors are orthogonal axes (cycle ⊥ activity ⊥ reachability)
falsifier_eval.F329_3_DESCRIPTOR_INDEPENDENCE: PASS — measurements are mechanically independent (proves the disagreement is real, not a measurement bug)
falsifier_eval.F329_4_ANCHOR_SANITY: PASS — rule_0 collapses ALL descriptors uniformly (1.0, 0.0, 1); rule_204 identity hits the bijection ceiling on C while staying baseline on A and B — exposes C as a class-blind descriptor

verdict_derived: 🔴 FALSIFIED — three independent ECA descriptors give three different top-rule rankings on the same panel. Metric-triangulation H1 (≥2 of 3 agree) decisively false. The rule_204 identity tying C with consc-class is a SPECIFIC discovery: descriptor C (unique-states-reached) is BIJECTION-blind — it rewards reversibility (every state has a unique predecessor) which the identity exemplifies. This reproduces and strengthens H_268's PARTIAL fragility verdict at the simplest non-Φ measurement layer: even pre-faithful descriptors disagree on substrate ranking.
structural_vs_dynamical: all 3 descriptors are DYNAMICAL (forward orbit derivatives), yet they disagree — refines H_326 raster further: 'DYNAMICAL → 🟢' applies to MATCHED descriptor-hypothesis pairs only, not across all dynamical measures of the same substrate.
honest_limits: n=4 panel; larger n might reduce descriptor disagreement (more headroom in each metric)
Single descriptor per axis; pairwise correlations across all 16 starts (not just tops) would give a richer agreement matrix
Top-rule majority is harsh; Spearman rank correlation would be a softer test
